maddeler.e:
اصطلحن (form VIII)
# اِصْطَلَحْنَ (iṣṭalaḥna) /isˤ.tˤa.laħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
# اُصْطُلِحْنَ (uṣṭuliḥna) /usˤ.tˤu.liħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
# اِصْطَلِحْنَ (iṣṭaliḥna) /isˤ.tˤa.liħ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
